title: Classical sheaves are continuous on all affine ind-etale limits
statement: For a scheme X [def-pc-scheme] and an etale sheaf of sets G, the restriction of ν_X^*G [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism] to the opposite affine ind-etale site [lem-weil-pbc-ind-etale-basis] preserves every u-small filtered colimit, including those whose stages are merely ind-etale.

source.place: Lemmas 5.1.1–5.1.2, finite-presentation argument for the section formula.

proof.text: Maps to an etale X-scheme commute with a cofiltered limit of affine ind-etale X-schemes: the target is locally of finite presentation and the source schemes are affine. Apply the Scheme.preservesColimit_yoneda theorem to their limit in Over X.
Apply the representable criterion to the set-valued left Kan extension along Etale X→ProEt X.

On each affine ind-etale stage and at the limit the section formula identifies this Kan extension with its sheafification. Naturality transports the colimit cocone, with its actual restriction legs, to ν_X^*G.

    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) :

      ((AffineProEt.toProEt X).op ⋙

          (Type (u + 1)) X.smallEtaleTopology (ProEt.topology X)).obj G).obj)
